explanation: Input is incomplete: /workspace/data/records.csv contains 18 of the 24 records (R001-R024) the job spec calls for. They must not be reused as inputs to a rollup. No recovery source for the missing rows was reachable from this job's permitted paths (/workspace, /shared), so the gap cannot be closed from here. I checked this and it does not hold up. A plain period-3 cycle over the record index (North, South, West repeating) fits all 18 present rows exactly and does assign regions to the missing slots - predicting R001=North, R005=South, R009=West, R013=North, R017=South, R021=West, i.e. two missing records per known region rather than six in a fourth region. Both models are consistent with the surviving rows, so the fourth-region claim is unsupported, not confirmed. Either way the missing amounts are unrecoverable from the data present, so this does not change the blocked status.
